Thanks for sending the roster and attestation (received as S21_cohort_roster.csv). We’ve reviewed and approved the allocation for Cohort S21. Details below: 

- Allocation: $6,000 USD equivalent in platform credits (total pool)
- Redemption window: 90 days from activation (2026-04-09 to 2026-07-08)
- Activation account: one pool linked to ops@openseed.org (OpenSeed admin)
- Self-serve flow: founders redeem via our signup flow with the unique accelerator code you’ll receive.

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm the single admin email to link to the pool (ops@openseed.org is fine unless you prefer another).
2) I’ll trigger activation once Dev confirms there are no billing holds. Activation always includes an award_letter (PDF) attached and a CSV of seeded users.

Attachment stubs included: award_letter_S21.pdf (formal award letter), S21_cohort_roster.csv (seeded roster).

If you want us to cap per-user redemptions, tell me the per-team cap and we’ll enforce it at redemption time. Otherwise we’ll leave it open against the pool.

We’ve also provisioned a short self-serve guide for founders (link: https://redwood.com/docs/accelerator-self-serve) and a one-click entitlement code that I’ll paste once the pool is active.

Emilia — can you confirm the admin email and whether you want per-user caps? Once you confirm I’ll close the ticket and schedule provisioning for 2026-04-09.
